candidates: tests/base/src/test/java/org/keycloak/tests/admin/group/GroupTest.java:139 - Reader thread is never joined, so the assertion can miss exceptions and the thread can loop forever.. The test sets `deletedAll` and then checks `caughtExceptions` straight away. It never waits for the reader thread. A request that is still running when the flag flips, which is the window most likely to hit a deleted group, can add its exception after `assertThat` has already passed, so the test can miss the NPE it is meant to catch. If any `remove()` call throws, `deletedAll.set(true)` never runs and the reader thread keeps calling the admin API with no end, still running after the test and realm cleanup finish. Keep the `Thread` reference, put the deletes in `try { ... } finally { deletedAll.set(true); }`, and call `thread.join()` before the assertion. Making it a daemon thread would also help.
